system_prompt_style.note: Base system prompt plus workflow memory file appended at runtime.

env_context_strategy.note: Environment knowledge comes from the live accessibility tree observation per step.

context_compaction.note: fit_tokens shrinks the prompt to a token budget; mind2web/memory.py additionally drops exemplars when over the limit.

observation_format.note: Screenshots reachable via flags.use_screenshot in the legacy agent.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
In order to accomplish my goal I need to click on the button with bid 12
```click("12")```
tool_call_format.note: Actions are BrowserGym function-call code strings parsed from text.

tool_count.note: Action set is BrowserGym's HighLevelActionSet subsets [chat, bid]; the number of individual actions is not stated in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
action_set = HighLevelActionSet(

edit_primitive.note: Web-navigation actions only; no file editing tool.

tool_schema_source.note: Action descriptions come from BrowserGym's authored action-set documentation rendered into the prompt.

protocol_standardization.note: No mcp/a2a code or dependency appears in the 51-file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: This observe-act loop iterates until the model predicts the stop action ai =STOP, or reaches a task termination condition
loop_primitives.note: Online AWM adds an evaluator-gated induce/integrate loop across tasks: 'the agents conduct the loop of induce, integrate, and utilize workflows'.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Review the current state of the page and all other information to find the best
possible next action to accomplish your goal.
planning_granularity.note: No stored plan object; reasoning is free text in <think>.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
class DemoAgent(Agent):
    """A basic agent using OpenAI API, to demonstrate BrowserGym's functionalities."""
multi_agent_topology.note: One acting agent; separate LM evaluator and inducer are modules, not delegated agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: AWM online can also run in an supervision-free setting, where it iteratively induces workflows from self-generated past predictions that are judged correct by an evaluator module.
human_in_loop.note: No confirmation/approval hook in the agent loop.

short_term_state.note: Lists of observations/actions/thoughts are rendered into the prompt; close to conversation-only.

long_term_memory.note: Induced workflows persisted to workflow/*.txt and re-injected across tasks; AWM_AS also wraps them as callable actions.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: workflows += "\n\nclick('id') # input string id value for all actions"
state_persistence.note: Workflow files persist across runs but no agent-run resume path is present.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We adopt the LM-based evaluation model of Pan et al. (2024) to output a binary label, Leval(et) ∈ {0, 1}, that judges if et successfully solves qt by prompting a neural model.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This observe-act loop iterates until the model predicts the stop action ai =STOP, or reaches a task termination condition
retry_policy.note: max_retry=4 in the legacy agent is step-level parse-error requery, not a task retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: until the model predicts the stop action ai =STOP, or reaches a task termination condition, e.g., a maximum pre-determined number of steps.

timeouts.note: No timeout parameters in the agent code shown.

execution_isolation.note: Actions execute in a locally launched Playwright browser via BrowserGym; no container config in the repo.
